statements.label: supported
statements.text: In mice, fat-tissue activin A rose as the animals grew older.
statements.evidence: Mouse fat tissue activin A increased with aging.
statements.note: The abstract states mouse fat tissue activin A increased with aging.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Senescent-cell clearance extended the lifespan of the naturally-aged mice.
statements.evidence: Clearing senescent cells from 18-month-old naturally-aged INK-ATTAC mice reduced circulating activin A, blunted fat loss, and enhanced adipogenic transcription factor expression within 3 weeks.
statements.note: The abstract reports fat and activin A effects of clearance within 3 weeks but never mentions survival or lifespan.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Eight weeks of the JAK1/2 inhibitor ruxolitinib lowered circulating activin A and preserved fat mass in 22-month-old mice.
statements.evidence: Eight weeks-treatment with ruxolitinib, an FDA-approved JAK1/2 inhibitor, reduced circulating activin A, preserved fat mass, reduced lipotoxicity, and increased insulin sensitivity in 22-month-old mice.
statements.note: The abstract reports eight-week ruxolitinib reduced circulating activin A and preserved fat mass in 22-month-old mice.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Primary human senescent fat progenitors release activin A and directly block adipogenesis in non-senescent progenitors.
statements.evidence: primary human senescent fat progenitors secrete activin A and directly inhibit adipogenesis in non-senescent progenitors
statements.note: The abstract states senescent human fat progenitors secrete activin A and inhibit adipogenesis in non-senescent progenitors.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: A small-molecule Nlrp3 inhibitor was given to aged mice and delayed the onset of chronic age-related diseases.
statements.evidence: These studies reveal Nlrp3 inflammasome as an upstream target that controls age-related inflammation and offer an innovative therapeutic strategy to lower Nlrp3 activity to delay multiple age-related chronic diseases.
statements.note: The abstract proposes lowering Nlrp3 activity as a strategy but reports only genetic ablation, not any drug treatment.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Deleting the Nlrp3 inflammasome protected mice against age-related rises in innate immune activation, CNS transcriptome changes, and astrogliosis.
statements.evidence: Ablation of Nlrp3 inflammasome protected mice from age-related increases in the innate immune activation, alterations in CNS transcriptome, and astrogliosis.
statements.note: The abstract states Nlrp3 ablation protected mice from these age-related increases.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In aged mice, IL-1 accounted only for the Nlrp3 inflammasome-dependent gains in cognitive function and motor performance.
statements.evidence: Notably, IL-1 mediated only Nlrp3 inflammasome-dependent improvement in cognitive function and motor performance in aged mice.
statements.note: The abstract states IL-1 mediated only the Nlrp3-dependent cognitive and motor improvements in aged mice.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Reduced caspase-1 activity in Nlrp3-deficient mice improved glycemic control and lessened bone loss and thymic involution.
statements.evidence: the deficient Nlrp3 inflammasome-mediated caspase-1 activity improved glycemic control and attenuated bone loss and thymic demise.
statements.note: The abstract states deficient Nlrp3-mediated caspase-1 activity improved glycemic control and attenuated bone loss and thymic demise.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Mice lacking nfkb1 showed reduced tissue regeneration in the liver and gut.
statements.evidence: We also show that these mice have reduced regeneration in liver and gut.
statements.note: The abstract states the nfkb1-knockout mice have reduced regeneration in liver and gut.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Chronic low-grade inflammation caused by nfkb1 knockout drives premature ageing in mice.
statements.evidence: chronic, progressive low-grade inflammation induced by knockout of the nfkb1 subunit of the transcription factor NF-κB induces premature ageing in mice.
statements.note: The abstract states nfkb1-knockout-induced chronic inflammation induces premature ageing in mice.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: The premature ageing of nfkb1-knockout mice was accompanied by cognitive decline.
statements.evidence: Frequencies of senescent cells in liver and intestinal crypts quantitatively predict mean and maximum lifespan in both short- and long-lived mice cohorts.
statements.note: The abstract examines liver, gut and fibroblasts but never assesses cognition or neural function.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Anti-inflammatory or antioxidant treatment blocked senescent-cell accumulation in nfkb1-/- tissues and restored their regenerative potential.
statements.evidence: Preferential accumulation of telomere-dysfunctional senescent cells in nfkb1(-/-) tissues is blocked by anti-inflammatory or antioxidant treatment of mice, and this rescues tissue regenerative potential.
statements.note: The abstract states such treatment blocks senescent-cell accumulation and rescues regenerative potential.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Proliferative failure in these HIV-specific CD8+ T cells was marked by surface CD57, not by loss of CD28 or CCR7.
statements.evidence: This lack of proliferative ability of HIV-specific CD8(+) T cells is defined by surface expression of CD57 but not by absence of CD28 or CCR7.
statements.note: The abstract states the proliferative failure is defined by CD57, not by absence of CD28 or CCR7.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Adding exogenous IL-7 restored the proliferative capacity of the HIV-specific CD8+ T cells.
statements.evidence: This inability to proliferate in response to antigen cannot be overcome by exogenous interleukin-2 (IL-2) or IL-15.
statements.note: The abstract reports IL-2 and IL-15 failed to rescue proliferation but never tests IL-7.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: A large fraction of cytokine-producing HIV-specific CD8+ T cells failed to divide and died during a 48-hour in vitro culture.
statements.evidence: a large proportion of HIV-specific CD8(+) T cells that produce cytokines in response to cognate antigen are unable to divide and die during a 48-hour in vitro culture.
statements.note: The abstract states many such cytokine-producing cells cannot divide and die within the 48-hour culture.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Across CD8+, CD4+ T cells and NK cells, CD57 marked proliferative inability, a history of more cell divisions, and short telomeres.
statements.evidence: CD57 expression on CD8(+) T cells, CD4(+) T cells, and NK cells is a general marker of proliferative inability, a history of more cell divisions, and short telomeres.
statements.note: The abstract states CD57 marks proliferative inability, more prior divisions, and short telomeres across these cell types.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Cross-sectional data showed neutrophil migratory behavior begins to change in the sixth decade of life.
statements.evidence: Cross-sectional data indicate that migratory behavior changes in the sixth decade of life.
statements.note: The abstract states migratory behavior changes in the sixth decade of life.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Neutrophils from healthy older subjects showed reduced chemotaxis but preserved chemokinesis toward inflammatory stimuli.
statements.evidence: reduced chemotaxis but preserved chemokinesis toward a range of inflammatory stimuli in migrating neutrophils isolated from healthy older subjects.
statements.note: The abstract describes reduced chemotaxis but preserved chemokinesis in older subjects' neutrophils.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Treating older patients with a PI3K inhibitor lowered their rate of bacterial infections.
statements.evidence: Targeting PI3K signaling may therefore offer a new strategy in improving neutrophil functions during infections and reduce inappropriate inflammation in older patients.
statements.note: The abstract proposes PI3K targeting during infections but does not test infection rates in patients.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Inhibiting PI3Kγ or PI3Kδ restored neutrophil migratory accuracy, whereas SHIP1 inhibition worsened the migratory defects.
statements.evidence: inhibition of PI3Kγ or PI3Kδ, restored neutrophil migratory accuracy, whereas SHIP1 inhibition worsened migratory flaws.
statements.note: The abstract reports PI3Kγ/PI3Kδ inhibition restored accuracy while SHIP1 inhibition worsened it.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Elevated Cdc42 activity in aged HSCs was causally linked to their aging and correlated with a loss of polarity.
statements.evidence: elevated activity of the small RhoGTPase Cdc42 in aged HSCs is causally linked to HSC aging and correlates with a loss of polarity in aged HSCs.
statements.note: The abstract states elevated Cdc42 activity is causally linked to HSC aging and correlates with loss of polarity.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Aging-related hematopoietic decline includes a progressive reduction in immune response and an increased incidence of myeloid malignancy.
statements.evidence: The decline in hematopoietic function seen during aging involves a progressive reduction in the immune response and an increased incidence of myeloid malignancy
statements.note: The abstract states aging hematopoietic decline involves reduced immune response and more myeloid malignancy.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Pharmacological inhibition of Cdc42 rejuvenated aged HSCs and raised the percentage of polarized cells in the aged population.
statements.evidence: Pharmacological inhibition of Cdc42 activity functionally rejuvenates aged HSCs, increases the percentage of polarized cells in an aged HSC population
statements.note: The abstract states Cdc42 inhibition rejuvenates aged HSCs and increases the percentage of polarized cells.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Inhibiting Cdc42 reduced the incidence of myeloid malignancy in aged mice.
statements.evidence: Our data therefore suggest a mechanistic role for Cdc42 activity in HSC biology and epigenetic regulation, and identify Cdc42 activity as a pharmacological target for ameliorating stem cell aging.
statements.note: The abstract identifies Cdc42 as a target for stem cell aging but does not measure malignancy outcomes.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Irradiated LKS+ HSCs showed increased p16(Ink4a) and SA-beta-gal, while irradiated LKS- progenitors showed no such change.
statements.evidence: LKS+ HSCs from irradiated mice exhibited an increased expression of the 2 commonly used biomarkers of cellular senescence, p16(Ink4a) and SA-beta-gal. In contrast, no such changes were observed in irradiated LKS- hematopoietic progenitor cells.
statements.note: The abstract reports senescence biomarkers rose in LKS+ HSCs but not in LKS- progenitors.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Chemotherapeutic agents induced HSC senescence through the same p16(Ink4a) and SA-beta-gal markers.
statements.evidence: Exposure to ionizing radiation (IR) and certain chemotherapeutic agents not only causes acute bone marrow (BM) suppression but also leads to long-term residual hematopoietic injury.
statements.note: The abstract names chemotherapy as a cause of injury but tests only irradiation for senescence induction.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: A sublethal 6.5 Gy total-body irradiation of C57BL/6 mice produced a sustained reduction of LKS+ HSCs.
statements.evidence: exposure of C57BL/6 mice to a sublethal dose (6.5 Gy) of total body irradiation (TBI) resulted in a sustained quantitative and qualitative reduction of LKS+ HSCs.
statements.note: The abstract reports 6.5 Gy TBI caused a sustained reduction of LKS+ HSCs.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: HSC senescence coincided with prolonged elevation of p21, p19(Arf) and p16(Ink4a) mRNA, while p27(Kip1) and p18(Ink4c) were not increased.
statements.evidence: the induction of HSC senescence was associated with a prolonged elevation of p21(Cip1/Waf1), p19(Arf), and p16(Ink4a) mRNA expression, while the expression of p27(Kip1) and p18(Ink4c) mRNA was not increased following TBI.
statements.note: The abstract reports prolonged elevation of p21, p19Arf and p16 mRNA, but not p27Kip1 or p18Ink4c.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Methylation at three CpGs in ITGA2B, ASPA and PDE4C was measured by bisulfite pyrosequencing of 151 blood samples.
statements.evidence: Methylation levels at three age-related CpGs--located in the genes ITGA2B, ASPA and PDE4C--were subsequently analyzed by bisulfite pyrosequencing of 151 blood samples.
statements.note: The abstract reports three CpGs in these genes were pyrosequenced in 151 blood samples.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The methylation signature predicted age more precisely than predictions based on telomere length.
statements.evidence: This precision is higher than age predictions based on telomere length.
statements.note: The abstract states the signature's precision is higher than telomere-length-based age predictions.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: The methylation aging signature also predicted age accurately in tissues other than blood.
statements.evidence: Our epigenetic aging signature provides a simple biomarker to estimate the state of aging in blood.
statements.note: The abstract develops and validates the signature in blood only and does not test other tissues.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The epigenetic signature predicted age with a mean absolute deviation from chronological age of less than 5 years.
statements.evidence: This epigenetic aging signature facilitates age predictions with a mean absolute deviation from chronological age of less than 5 years.
statements.note: The abstract reports a mean absolute deviation from chronological age of less than 5 years.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Before midlife, faster-aging individuals were less physically able, showed cognitive decline, reported worse health, and looked older.
statements.evidence: individuals who were aging more rapidly were less physically able, showed cognitive decline and brain aging, self-reported worse health, and looked older.
statements.note: The abstract states more rapidly aging individuals were less able, declined cognitively, reported worse health, and looked older.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The study tracked aging in 954 Dunedin cohort members across three time points in their third and fourth decades.
statements.evidence: We studied aging in 954 young humans, the Dunedin Study birth cohort, tracking multiple biomarkers across three time points spanning their third and fourth decades of life.
statements.note: The abstract reports 954 Dunedin cohort participants tracked across three time points in their third and fourth decades.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: A rejuvenation therapy applied to the cohort slowed their measured biological aging.
statements.evidence: Measured biological aging in young adults can be used to identify causes of aging and evaluate rejuvenation therapies.
statements.note: The abstract proposes the measure for evaluating rejuvenation therapies but tests no such therapy.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Two aging-measurement methods, one cross-sectional and one longitudinal, were developed and validated for young adults.
statements.evidence: We developed and validated two methods by which aging can be measured in young adults, one cross-sectional and one longitudinal.
statements.note: The abstract states two methods, cross-sectional and longitudinal, were developed and validated.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: TRF2 and POT1 act independently to repress the two pathways: TRF2 represses ATM, while POT1 prevents ATR activation.
statements.evidence: The data indicate that TRF2 and POT1 act independently to repress these two DNA damage response pathways. TRF2 represses ATM, whereas POT1 prevents activation of ATR.
statements.note: The abstract states TRF2 and POT1 act independently, TRF2 repressing ATM and POT1 preventing ATR activation.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Damaged mammalian telomeres can activate both the ATM and the ATR DNA-damage signalling pathways.
statements.evidence: damaged mammalian telomeres can activate both ATM and ATR
statements.note: The abstract shows damaged mammalian telomeres can activate both ATM and ATR.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Shortened telomeres drive replicative senescence and genome instability, which these mechanisms help explain.
statements.evidence: provide an explanation for the induction of replicative senescence and genome instability by shortened telomeres.
statements.note: The abstract states shortened telomeres induce replicative senescence and genome instability.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Depleting both TRF2 and POT1 caused more severe telomere dysfunction than depleting either one alone.
statements.evidence: We analysed the telomere damage response on depletion of either or both of the shelterin proteins telomeric repeat binding factor 2 (TRF2) and protection of telomeres 1 (POT1) from cells lacking ATM and/or ATR kinase signalling.
statements.note: The abstract reports analyzing single and double depletions but does not compare their severity.
